As Policy Advisor for Defence & Restoration - Voltage Control , you contribute directly to the resilience, security, and restoration capability of the electricity system. Does it sound like the right challenge for you?  - There's no set closing date. - As long as the position is still open on our website, you can apply. - A cover letter is optional, but we strongly recommend including one, as it helps us better understand your application. Your contribution to TenneT You develop policies and frameworks that enable effective normal system control to avoid system disturbances, and policies to support large-scale restoration scenarios. You enrich the existing defense and restoration plan with policies for voltage collapse events, a lessons learned from the 2025 blackout in Spain and Portugal. Working with internal and external stakeholders, you translate complex technical challenges into practical and understandable policies that strengthen system resilience and support compliance with European network codes.
